notes: Identity independently checked: canonical text carries the title Red, Rank, and Romance in Women Viewing Men; all seven named authors; Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 2010, 139(3), 399–417; DOI 10.1037/a0019689. This is a full primary journal-article text with methods, results, and references, not an abstract or secondary discussion. No PDF path was supplied. 16 (red) + 17 (gray) = 33 female undergraduate participants. Mutually exclusive conditions in the primary Experiment 3 independent-samples tests; no N derived from df. One purpose-aware participant was omitted only in a separately reported sensitivity reanalysis, whose exact condition-specific counts are not supplied; that reanalysis is not substituted for the main test. Targets identified by Experiment 3 and the named outcome measures, not by input order or numerical correspondence.
